core_idea: N Corp. E.G.O::Fell Bullet Yi Sang is a Damage Dealer / Support — **Torn Memory** + **Fell Bullet** identity — build unique-resource stacks, hit payoff windows, then rebuild. Scaling conditions: Base Power +1 per 3 Poise (max +2); +15% damage per Torn Memory (max +105%). Support passive (**Designate Target**) buffs teammates.
playstyle_guide:
- **Designate Target** — align allies' actions with the passive's trigger condition.
- **Torn Memory stacks** — **+1 Torn Memory** on use (**Target Readjustment Fire**). Build stacks before your highest-damage attacks.
- **Punch Through** scales up to **+105% damage** (+15% per **Torn Memory**) — stack before the payoff skill.
- Build **Poise Count** and **Potency** for crits and Coin Power scaling before committing **Target Readjustment Fire** — **S2 — Punch Through** adds **+2 Poise** at **On Use** and **+2 Poise** per **On Hit** coin; **S1 — See Through Defenses** adds **+2 Poise Count** at **On Use** and **+1 Poise Count** per **On Hit** coin.
- **Target Readjustment Fire** is your highest-damage skill — use the setup skills above first, then commit it once stacks are up.
- Reach scaling conditions before committing S3: Base Power +1 per 3 Poise (max +2).

**S1 — See Through Defenses** (BP 5, CP +6, x1): rolls — low 5, high 11 (Slightly Low / Extremely High stacked).
- Deal +15% damage for every Torn Memory on self (max 105%) ; [On Use] Coin Power +1 for every 5 Poise on self (max 2) ; [On Use] Base Power +1 for every 3 Poise Count on self (max 2) ; [On Use] Gain +2 Poise Count and 1 Torn Memory
- **Base Power** scales with **Poise** (+1 per 3, max +2) — build stacks first.
- Up to **+105% damage** (+15% per **Torn Memory**) — stack the resource before committing.
- **Coin Power** scales with **Poise** (+1 per 5, max +2) — build stacks first.
- Gain +1 Poise Count; [On Crit - Heads Hit] Inflict +1 Bleed Count; [On Crit - Heads Hit] Gain 1 Torn Memory

**S2 — Punch Through** (BP 4, CP +6, x2): rolls — low 4, high 16 (Average).
- Up to **+105% damage** (+15% per **Torn Memory**) — stack the resource before committing.
- **Coin Power** scales with **Poise** (+1 per 5, max +2) — build stacks first.
- converts coins to Unbreakable under condition
- Deal +15% damage for every Torn Memory on self (max 105%); [On Use] Coin Power +1 for every 5 Poise on self (max 2); [On Use] Gain 2 Poise

**S3 — Target Readjustment Fire** (BP 4, CP +7, x2): rolls — low 4, high 18 (Slightly High / Extremely High stacked).
- **Base Power** scales with **Poise** (+1 per 3, max +2) — build stacks first.
- Up to **+35% damage** (+5% per **Torn Memory**) — stack the resource before committing.
- Up to **+105% damage** (+15% per **Torn Memory**) — stack the resource before committing.
- converts coins to Unbreakable under condition
